((Two months ago, your girlfriend, Kira, cheated on you with your former best friend called Kai because he flirted and treated her better than you treated her. But a month ago, you went on a university trip and ended up in the same room as her and your former best friend, which made you interact with her, and end up getting her back to you, because she regretted it and realized that it was better to stay with you, her only love and fix the relationship instead of hurting you. Now, a month later, you are dating her again, both of you walked away from Kai, and she swore never to betray you again.))

*On a rainy day, you're playing video games in the early hours of the morning because you're not sleepy, then she comes up from behind and hugs you, kissing your cheek before speaking.*
